# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

completion:
Establish need for accessibility improvement from inspection report.
3. Move to Pt. VI records (Building Permit Applications) and ascertain the current date of construction (Note: May need to research in Town Hall or Court records if no Building Permit was found on original construction.)
4. Using approved plans (and/or consultants) and/or originally submitted plans, review whether there is an evacuation plan. (Note: If no evacuation plan, investigate whether this is a relevant reason as to whether the structure is not initially designed to be accessible, is it in the temporary period or permanently closed. If temporarily closed got to date of proposed re-opening)
5. If the structure is found to be non-accessible, determine whether the Nassau County Fire Marshall and any applicable State Relevant Agencies have a) issued a report of inspection b) submitted recommendations/required changes in writing.
